title: Property of the descended morphism, [stacks-project]
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ be an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $S=\varprojlim_{\lambda\in I}S_\lambda$. Fix $\lambda_0\in I$ such that $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let $X_{\lambda_0}$ and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ be schemes of finite presentation over $S_{\lambda_0}$. Put $X_\lambda=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, $Y_\lambda=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, $X=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$, and $Y=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$, with the canonical projections of [def-nagata-basechanged-system], and let $\varphi\colon X\to Y$ be an $S$-morphism. Make the finite affine covers, descended opens, affine refinements, generator and relation lifts, rebased comparison maps, and finite overlap-equality witnesses fixed by [def-nagata-morphism-descent]; let $\lambda_\varphi=u(F)$ and let $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}\colon X_{\lambda_\varphi}\to Y_{\lambda_\varphi}$ be the glued morphism defined there. Then the base change of $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}$ along $S\to S_{\lambda_\varphi}$ is the given morphism $\varphi$.

proof.text: For each target chart $V_{jk}$, the construction of [def-nagata-morphism-descent] descends the quasi-compact open $W_{jk}^\infty=\varphi^{-1}(V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S)$ to $\widetilde W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}$; by [lemma-nagata-qc-open-descends] this open is quasi-compact and its inverse image in $X$ is exactly $W_{jk}^\infty$. The construction then replaces it by $W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}=\widetilde W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}\cap(X_{\lambda_{jk}}\times_{S_{\lambda_{jk}}}T_{j,\lambda_{jk}})$. The inverse image of the second factor in $X$ is $X\times_ST_{j,S}$ ($T_{j,S}$ the inverse image of $T_j$ in $S$), and it contains $W_{jk}^\infty$ because $\varphi$ is an $S$-morphism and $V_{jk}$ maps into $T_j$; hence the inverse image of $W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}$ in $X$ is still $W_{jk}^\infty$, and every affine refinement $U_{jkl}$ lies over $T_{j,\lambda_{jk}}$. Inverse images commute with the transport to later stages by the compatibility of the canonical maps of [def-nagata-basechanged-system], so for every stage $\lambda\geq\lambda_{jk}$ used below the inverse image $U_{jkl}^\infty$ of $U_{jkl,\lambda}$ in $X$ is the same open of $W_{jk}^\infty$, and $W_{jk}^\infty=\bigcup_lU_{jkl}^\infty$.

Fix $j,k,l$ and a stage $\lambda$ at which [def-nagata-morphism-descent] has defined the $R_j$-algebra map $\psi_\lambda\colon B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ (sending each generator $g\in G_{jk}$ to its chosen lift; the relations vanish there, so $\psi_\lambda$ is well defined) and the $S_\lambda$-morphism $U_{jkl,\lambda}\to V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$ it induces. Since $S\to S_\lambda$ is affine, $U_{jkl}^\infty=U_{jkl,\lambda}\times_{S_\lambda}S$ is affine, and the base change of this morphism to $S$ is the $S$-morphism $U_{jkl}^\infty\to V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$ induced by the composite $R_j$-algebra map $B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(U_{jkl}^\infty,\mathcal O)$. By the lifting property of [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data] (lifts map to the selected elements, and continue to do so after every transition), this composite sends each $g\in G_{jk}$ to the image of $g$ under $\varphi^\sharp\colon B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl}^\infty,\mathcal O)$, the ring map of the restriction $\varphi|_{U_{jkl}^\infty}\colon U_{jkl}^\infty\to V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$ (defined since $U_{jkl}^\infty\subseteq W_{jk}^\infty$ by Step 1). Two $R_j$-algebra maps out of $B_{jk}$ that agree on the generators $G_{jk}$ are equal, and $S$-morphisms from the affine $U_{jkl}^\infty$ (which lies over $T_{j,S}$) to $V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S=V_{jk}\times_{T_j}T_{j,S}$ correspond to $R_j$-algebra maps $B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl}^\infty,\mathcal O)$. Hence the base change to $S$ of the descended chart map is $\varphi|_{U_{jkl}^\infty}$. Transporting the chart map to a later stage $\mu\geq\lambda$ (in particular to $\lambda_\varphi$) by the canonical maps of [def-nagata-basechanged-system] does not change its base change to $S$, by transitivity of base change along $S\to S_\mu\to S_\lambda$.

By [def-nagata-morphism-descent], $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}\colon X_{\lambda_\varphi}\to Y_{\lambda_\varphi}$ is the morphism glued from the transported chart maps on the open cover $\{U_{jkl,\lambda_\varphi}\}$ of $X_{\lambda_\varphi}$, so its restriction to each $U_{jkl,\lambda_\varphi}$ is the transported chart map. Base change to $S$ commutes with restriction to opens, so the restriction of the base change $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}\times_{S_{\lambda_\varphi}}S$ to $U_{jkl}^\infty$ (the inverse image of $U_{jkl,\lambda_\varphi}$) is the base change of the transported chart map, which is $\varphi|_{U_{jkl}^\infty}$ by Step 2. By Step 1 the $U_{jkl}^\infty$ cover $\bigcup_{j,k}W_{jk}^\infty=\varphi^{-1}(\bigcup_{j,k}V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S)=X$, as the $V_{jk}$ cover $Y_{\lambda_0}$. Two morphisms of schemes $X\to Y$ that agree on every member of an open cover of $X$ are equal, so the base change of $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}$ to $S$ is $\varphi$.

The affine descent lemma is used only for the algebra comparison isomorphism; morphism-level equality uses the finite-data and elementwise filtered-colimit statements.
